# Fabric.js

Vendored from the npm package `fabric@5.3.0`, unmodified (`dist/fabric.min.js`).

- Upstream: https://github.com/fabricjs/fabric.js
- Licence: MIT — see `LICENSE`.

Loaded only by the invoice template canvas (`settings/invoice_template.php`). It
gives the canvas selectable, draggable, resizable objects with per-object font
controls, which is what the template editor needs; it is not part of the main
application bundle, so no other page pays for it.
